i.norm: Non-ASCII characters (U+0080 and above) are valid CSS identifier code points and must be returned as-is by escapeCssIdentifier (no escaping applied). U+008C is a C1 control character that is >= 0x80, so it qualifies as non-ASCII and should pass through unchanged.
U+008C is a non-ASCII character (>= U+0080); CSS spec treats it as a valid ident code point
Non-ASCII characters are not escaped -- the output should equal the input
